description: Market gaps: where the same food costs 2-50x more in the same country. Within-country market price gaps for food, fuel and wages in 69 low- and middle-income countries: for each commodity, the cheapest and the dearest market in the latest month it was priced, the ratio, distance between the two, and pairs of markets that stayed cheapest/dearest for many months. Built monthly from WFP market price monitoring (HDX, CC BY-IGO). Facts, not trading advice. Routes: /top (commodity, min_ratio, limit); /country (country*, commodity, limit); /countries; /persistent (country, commodity, min_months). Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /top, /country, /countries, /persistent. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
